page.overview:
What is Bonnie the Rabbit?

Bonnie is an animatronic rabbit and a minor character in the Fazbear Frights book series. He is the guitarist of the animatronic band at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza.

Bonnie is a blue animatronic rabbit with a lighter shade of indigo on both his stomach, inner ears and muzzle, and red eyes. He wears a red bowtie. He has thin black eyebrows with a slightly rounded head similar to Withered Bonnie.

Bonnie first appears performing on stage alongside Freddy and Chica in 1985, back when Jeff's Pizza was Freddy Fazbear's Pizza instead. Earlier on, Oswald absentmindedly drew animatronics, one of which was a bunny, most likely Bonnie himself.

Bonnie appears alongside Freddy, Chica, and Foxy in the abandoned Freddy Fazbear location.
